name: Spaghetti Bolognese with Tender Braised Meat Sauce
whyItWorks: Al dente spaghetti tossed in a slow-simmered bolognese sauce of finely ground beef and strained tomatoes. Cooking the beef thoroughly breaks down muscle fibers for effortless digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light sauce and skip crushed red pepper flakes or heavy grated cheese.
